desc: 夜间贴睡吸痘护痘，隔绝手抠防留印，轻薄透明隐形不闷痘
name: 水胶体隐形夜间痘痘贴款

shots.intent: 首屏点击：白盒正面加背面衬纸，红弧色块建立识别，规格清晰
痛点命中：真实痘点加贴片被白虚线圈注，大字喊出一贴见效
卖点落地：指尖贴于痘点，展示轻薄透明与防抠挤
机制可感：用后贴片白色吸出物微距，直观证明水胶体吸附
材质细节：指甲揭膜动作加透明边缘高光，证明轻薄随肤
信任建立：三条勾选（材质/肤质/测试）加大面积半透明贴片
地位压阵：深红幕布台座收拢信任感，不虚构任何声明
变体选择：多规格多贴数并列，暗示组合购与复购
收口转化：清洁、贴上、隔早撕除的三步图解降低使用门槛

style.backgroundSystem: pure white seamless for packshots; warm off-white paper panels for content pages; low-saturation pink gradients for on-face scenes; deep-red gradient curtain #8E1414 to #C22A20 reserved exclusively for the trust finale
style.direction: clinical-clean acne-care commerce: white and warm off-white paper panels punctuated by bold organic brand-red blocks, real skin texture for pain and mechanism proof
style.iconSystem: red circular checkmarks, black-and-white numbered round badges connected by dotted paths, white dotted focus rings, thin callout lines
style.lightingSystem: large frontal-top diffused softbox with zero hard shadows, subtle contact shadows only, transmitted backlight to reveal the patch translucency
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clinical-clean acne-care commerce built on a pure white seamless base #FFFFFF and warm off-white paper panels #F5F1E9, punctuated by bold organic brand-red blocks #E8402A with coral accents #F08072; the deep-red gradient curtain #8E1414 to #C22A20 with a round pedestal is reserved exclusively for the trust finale. Lighting is always soft - large frontal-top diffused key, zero hard shadows, subtle contact shadows, transmitted backlight for the patch translucency. Ultra-bold geometric sans headlines in near-black #1A1A1A or pure white, one message per frame. Icon language: red circular checkmarks, numbered round badges on dotted paths, white dotted focus rings, thin callout lines. Real unretouched skin carries the pain and mechanism close-ups with the patch razor sharp at focus. Never introduce teal or blue-purple sub-brand colors, never show brand logos or original packaging copy, never fabricate certifications, rankings or sales claims, never use hard light or over-smoothed skin.
noDrift: no teal or blue-purple sub-brand colors
no hard light or heavy shadows
no brand logos or packaging copy
no fabricated certifications, rankings or sales numbers
style.presentationRules: the patch is always the focal point or highlighted by a white dotted focus ring; skin texture stays real without smoothing
style.surfaceSystem: seamless paper and matte white acrylic; real unretouched skin as the surface for close-ups; velvet curtain pedestal only on the trust finale
style.typography: ultra-bold geometric sans-serif headlines in near-black or pure white, one message per frame, thin supporting body
